basics.name: Nour Aldeen Tofi
basics.label: Frontend & AI Engineer: React and TypeScript Interfaces, LLM Agents, Arabic Document AI, MCP · n8n Automation
basics.summary: I build React and TypeScript interfaces and the AI behind them: applications on large language models that take over manual work in Arabic and English.

work.name: Self-employed
highlights: Built Gambit Tournaments, the tournament platform of a chess club in Dammam, in Next.js, React, Prisma and MySQL: upcoming tournaments with live seats, guest registration in Arabic, English and Urdu, an archive of past tournaments, and an admin dashboard for tournaments, gallery and registrations.

Built its payment check in n8n: a vision model reads each uploaded bank-transfer receipt and first says whether it is a transfer at all, so registrations are confirmed without anyone opening a receipt by hand. The secret, contract version and image size are checked before any model call, and successful runs are not stored, because receipts carry personal data.

Designed and built eighteen websites for professionals, companies and shops, Gambit Tournaments among them, most of them in Arabic and English, each from its own visual idea, with bookings, orders and quote requests on WhatsApp where a business needs them and structured data that search engines and AI assistants can read.

work.name: Distinctive Frontier Co. for Safety Equipment L.L.C
highlights: Built the frontend of the company's custom CRM and quotation platform in React and TypeScript, in Arabic and English with full right-to-left support, replacing spreadsheets and hand-made quotes in every department.
With the platform, preparing a quotation took under two minutes once the data was entered, and all fifteen employees adopted it.

Built sales follow-up, purchase order drafts, sales analytics, real-time notifications and permission-based roles with route guards covered by Playwright tests, and developed the frontend of a second CRM for WAIS, the parent company.
Introduced workflow automation with n8n and the OpenAI API for the team's repetitive work, and used Claude Code daily to plan, build, test and review.
Coordinated requirements, user stories and API contracts between frontend, backend (Laravel) and UI/UX, so frontend and backend could build in parallel and delivery stayed on schedule.

work.name: NexLead
highlights: Coordinated client automation and software projects from requirements to release: scope, workflow design and acceptance.
Gathered requirements directly with clients, defined acceptance criteria, and broke work into tasks and user stories on Trello.
Tracked timelines and prepared cost estimates, and followed up on frontend, backend and UI/UX work until each release.
Coordinated the delivery of GoldenTag, a jewellery store management app the team built in Flutter, through to the Google Play Store.

work.name: Khwarizm Technologies
highlights: Developed a modern, responsive web application dashboard with React and Tailwind CSS as part of a full product team.
Converted detailed Figma designs into accessible, pixel-accurate interfaces with reusable components and efficient state management.
Conducted code reviews and upheld coding standards to deliver a clean, optimised codebase.

work.name: Minicodeleader
highlights: Designed responsive user interfaces for a kids education platform using React and Material-UI, where users browse courses, open lessons, and save courses for later.
Transformed Figma designs into functional interfaces with reusable components and optimised state management.
First professional React role, and the foundation for everything that followed.

references.name: Sameeh Hussein, Sales & Product Management · DFS · NM Fire Pumps
references.reference: Nour led the development of our customized CRM, demonstrating a strong ability to understand business needs and translate them into practical technology solutions. He worked closely with the sales and operation teams to ensure the system supported actual business workflows. Beyond his technical expertise, he showed strong leadership, effective planning, and commitment to results. He is reliable, responsive, and always open to feedback. I highly recommend Nour as a technology leader who combines technical expertise with a solid understanding of business needs.

references.name: Tareq Nasif, IT Service Delivery Manager · Software Engineering
references.reference: I had the pleasure of working with Nour as his Project Manager. He consistently demonstrated professionalism, proactivity, and a strong sense of ownership. Nour took initiative, independently drove topics forward, and actively contributed to achieving project goals. I appreciated his dedication, collaborative mindset, and positive impact on the team. I would gladly recommend him for future opportunities.

references.name: George Drouj, SDE @ noon · Codeforces Master · ACPC Bronze Medalist
references.reference: I had the pleasure of coaching Nour in 2021 for competitive programming contests. During our time working on data structures and algorithms, Nour stood out for his exceptionally sharp analytical mind and his ability to grasp complex concepts rapidly. He is a natural problem-solver who approaches challenges with both speed and precision.

references.name: Tawheed Malkat, IT Engineer · Senior UI/UX Designer · Product Designer
references.reference: I had the privilege of working with Nour Aldeen on the mobile development team at NexLead, and (as the person responsible for UI/UX) what distinguished his approach most was his focus on understanding before implementing. He was always careful to absorb the requirements fully and grasp the intent behind the design, so that implementation was never merely a visual translation but a coherent, logical user experience reflecting the design's core idea. He handled handoff and feedback with real professionalism: he asked precise questions and paid attention to details like consistency, edge cases, and user expectations. I recommend Nour Aldeen for any role requiring strong coordination between design and development, deep understanding of requirements, and genuine care for implementation quality through to delivery.

references.name: Hamza Shansho, Mobile Application Developer · Flutter Developer
references.reference: I was on the graduation project team with Nour Aldeen. I handled the Flutter mobile application, while Nour handled the most important part of the project: the core algorithm and the AI component that builds a suitable nutrition plan from user data. What impressed me was that he worked with an owner's mindset: he clarified the required inputs, defined the data flow and integration points, and explained the decision logic in a way that got the whole team aligned on the same picture. Whenever something was unclear, he went back to fundamentals: what is the goal, what are the constraints, and how do we guarantee a sensible result? His presence raised the quality of what we shipped, because his work was built on understanding and analysis rather than guesswork.
